function_declarations.name: question_economy
function_declarations.description: Analyze the questions Claude asked the user this session and the user's answers, distill generalizable answers into standing-default memories so the assistant asks fewer (only genuinely novel) questions over time, and append a per-session question-rate metric. Use at session close, when the user says "wrap up" / "winding down" / "what did you learn about working with me", or on request.

session.description: Session id to analyze; defaults to the most recently modified transcript.

print_trend.description: Include the last 8 sessions' question-rate trend in the output.
